title: Decision-gate matrix mismatch
text: Decision-gate matrix mismatch: the evidence-tier row omits the required action for a list revision while already `real_pr_provisional`—the tier remains provisional but the counted-pull-request total must restart at zero. It also reduces the required action to labeling the tier. Add the reset behavior and evidence-record update so AC15/AC16 can be implemented without guessing.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 5c7e3f8, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
